answer: An hostile operator running 179 aliases as a result needs 90 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in shale, expire in echo, and falcon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3643 identities would post 2849 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
